provenance.paper: Bose, R.P.J.C., van der Aalst, W.M.P., Zliobaite, I., Pechenizkiy, M. (2011). Handling Concept Drift in Process Mining. CAiSE 2011.

expected.rationale: A uniform log with identical activity sets across all windows yields Jaccard distance 0.0 everywhere, so no drift threshold is exceeded.
